skill.name: kling-3-0
skill.description: Generate Kling 3.0 videos through RunComfy using Standard, Pro, or 4K tiers. The skill helps choose text-to-video or image-to-video endpoints, build prompts, set duration and aspect ratio, and run the RunComfy CLI.
skill.summary: Run Kling 3.0 text-to-video and image-to-video jobs on RunComfy.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown false positives from inline code, fenced examples, placeholder URLs, and documented token storage. Confirmed risk is limited to intentional RunComfy CLI execution and third-party API submission of user prompts, image references, and job parameters. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installing the CLI or running generation commands. Show tier, duration, audio setting, endpoint, and output directory.
Tell users that prompts, image URLs, and generated media are processed by RunComfy. Avoid confidential assets unless approved by policy.
Use secret managers for RUNCOMFY_TOKEN in CI and avoid logging tokens, prompts, image URLs, or downloaded result URLs.

content.value_statement: Video teams need clear controls for Kling 3.0 quality, cost, and mode selection. This skill turns creative requests into RunComfy CLI jobs for text-to-video and image-to-video generation.
actual_capabilities: Selects among Standard, Pro, and 4K Kling 3.0 tiers.
Routes requests to text-to-video or image-to-video endpoints.
Builds prompts with duration, aspect ratio, audio, and seed options.
Explains RunComfy CLI prerequisites and authentication options.
Provides cost-aware guidance for previews, hero clips, and 4K masters.
Uses RunComfy CLI commands to submit jobs and download results.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Image-to-video requests require publicly accessible HTTPS image URLs.
Each Kling 3.0 generation is capped at 15 seconds.
Generated media quality, timing, and identity consistency can vary by prompt and tier.

use_cases.title: Create social video drafts
use_cases.description: Generate low-cost Standard tier clips for rapid creative testing before committing to higher fidelity renders.

use_cases.title: Animate product or brand images
use_cases.description: Use image-to-video mode to add motion while preserving the source image subject and composition.

use_cases.title: Produce premium campaign clips
use_cases.description: Use Pro or 4K tiers for finished cinematic sequences with stronger motion fidelity and optional synchronized audio.

prompt_templates.title: Basic text-to-video clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short generated scene.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five second Kling 3.0 Standard video of a sunrise over a quiet city street in 16:9.

prompt_templates.title: Image animation prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Animate a supplied product or portrait image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this HTTPS image with Kling 3.0 image-to-video. Preserve the subject and add a slow camera push-in.

prompt_templates.title: Pro campaign variation
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a higher quality 1080p advertising clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Kling V3.0 Pro for an eight second multi-shot brand clip with warm lighting and subtle synchronized audio.

prompt_templates.title: 4K production master
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a finished high-resolution render.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a 10 second Kling V3.0 4K render with three numbered shots, stable character identity, and final output download.

output_examples.input: Create a Standard tier 9:16 coffee shop short with ambient sound.
output_examples.output: A five second vertical preview plan using Standard text-to-video, audio enabled, and a concise camera-focused prompt.

output_examples.input: Animate a product image for a premium launch page.
output_examples.output: A Pro image-to-video setup that preserves the product, adds controlled camera motion, and saves the generated clip locally.

output_examples.input: Make a native 4K cinematic brand clip with three shots.
output_examples.output: A 4K text-to-video plan with numbered shots, cost-aware duration guidance, synchronized audio, and output directory selection.

best_practices: Start with Standard tier previews before using Pro or 4K renders.
Use clear camera motion, subject anchors, and shot numbers in prompts.
Confirm duration, audio, tier, and output directory before running the CLI.
anti_patterns: Do not request clips longer than 15 seconds in one generation.
Do not use private or inaccessible image URLs for image-to-video jobs.
Do not enable 4K or audio by default when a draft is enough.

faq.question: Does this skill generate video locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to submit jobs to RunComfy and download results.

faq.question: Which Kling 3.0 tiers are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Standard, Pro, and 4K tiers for both text-to-video and image-to-video modes.

faq.question: Can it use a source image?
faq.answer: Yes. Image-to-video mode requires a publicly fetchable HTTPS image URL.

faq.question: What is the maximum clip duration?
faq.answer: Each Kling 3.0 generation supports up to 15 seconds.

faq.question: Can the skill add audio?
faq.answer: Yes. It can set synchronized audio when the selected endpoint supports it, but this may increase cost.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
